meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆分开发任务为多个独立小改动,自动验证后逐个合并上线。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把开发任务变成多个独立小改动,逐个通过验证并合入主分支。
copy.tagline_en: Turn one dev task into small verified changes that merge one by one.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn dev tasks into small changes requiring individual review and merge.

howto.what: 把开发任务拆成多个能独立合并的小 PR,每个 PR 在单独的 git 工作树里开发,按 ulw-loop 流程实现并进行人工 QA(必须留下证据),然后生成面向审阅者的英文 PR,反复跑 CI 与 Cubic 直到通过,默认自动合并并清理工作树。
howto.when: 当你说“create a PR”“implement and PR”等触发词,或要求把改动以 PR 形式落地时接管。即使只说“implement X”,只要上下文暗示要交付 PR 也会触发。

say.text: 直接按这段需求实现,给每个改动创建小 PR 并合并。
say.note: Claude 会把它拆成多个独立 PR 逐个走流程。

say.text: 把这个功能实现成 PR,跑 CI 和 Cubic,通过后合并。
say.note: 若有失败会回到修改并重新验证。

say.text: 把这两个改动并行做成两个 PR,分别负责。
say.note: Claude 会为每个 PR 建独立工作树并行处理。

howto.what_en: Turns a task into small independently-mergeable PRs, each in its own git worktree: implement via ulw-loop with evidence-bound manual QA, create an English PR, verify with CI and Cubic until green, then merge and clean up.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like “create a PR” or “implement and PR”, or any request to land work as a PR; even a bare “implement X” triggers if PR delivery is implied.

say_en.text: Turn this request into small PRs and merge them one by one.
say_en.note: It will split and run full lifecycle per PR.

say_en.text: Implement this feature as a PR and see CI and Cubic through to merge.
say_en.note: Failing gates route back to fix and re-QA.

say_en.text: Build these two changes in parallel as separate PRs.
say_en.note: Each PR runs in its own worktree concurrently.
